definitions.gloss: cheering squad; pep squad; cheerleading team
definitions.explanation: An organized group that leads cheers and encourages athletes or competitors, especially at school sporting events. In Japan, traditional {応援団|おうえんだん} are known for their military-style discipline and coordinated chants.

definitions.gloss: support group; group of supporters; fan base
definitions.explanation: More broadly, any group of people who actively support a person, team, cause, or organization.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧ (support/cheering) + ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ (group/team). Japanese school {応援団|おうえんだん} are distinctive: they typically feature a ⟦{団長|だんちょう}→団長：12162_danchou⟧ (squad leader) in a traditional long coat who leads synchronized chants and gestures, quite different from Western cheerleading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {応援団|おうえんだん}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧: cheering squad leader
- {応援団|おうえんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join the cheering squad
- {応援団|おうえんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結成|けっせい}→結成：13809_kessei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to form a support group

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional school {応援団|おうえんだん} are known for strict hierarchical discipline, loud rhythmic cheering, and distinctive uniforms (often a long black coat called ⟦{学ラン|がくらん}→学ラン：18414_gakuran⟧). They are a staple of Japanese school culture and appear frequently in manga and anime.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- チアリーダー: cheerleader — Western-style cheerleading, now also common in Japan
- ⟦サポーター→サポーター：10954_sapootaa⟧: supporter — mainly used for sports fan groups
- ⟦{応援|おうえん}する→応援する：21988_ouensuru⟧: to cheer; to support — the verb form
